posts.subject: bhop_abandoned fix / delete
posts.bodyHtml:
Wenn man die cs:go bunny hop map: bhop_abandoned und noch paar andere maps, wie bop_adventure_csgo und wahrscheinlich noch mehr maps, die ich noch nicht alle "getestet" habe spielen will, dann stürzt der server ab und dann kommt wieder die map: bhop_dream_light_v1.
Deshalb würde ich mir wünschen, oder euch raten die maps aus dem server zu entfernen oder zu fixen.



~Dein OneEye

Kappa[/u]

Thanks for the reminder.


@OneEye is right, there is some maps which are crashing the server, not all the time for me, but sometimes, I will try to do a list to see which one are good and which one are not.


Maybe you have a list of the buggy maps already ?
I also believe that bhop_monster_jam isn't working.

Hello,


as far as I know, the issue is with the replay bot. For some reason, some maps like bhop_japan stopped working, when the WR bot is on the server. Disabling the plugin allows those maps to be played, but we decided to rather keep the replay functionality instead of some maps.
Maybe we could switch to another timer plugin ? @Nachtfrische

Zitat von Luckiris

Maybe we could switch to another timer plugin ? @Nachtfrische

We thought about that too but that would potentially reset all the times and would require us to redraw the start, end and level zones of each map, which would be a ton of work. There has to be a simpler solution, since those maps were working with the bot before.
